findings.message: The defs declare selectedTarefa (entry.params.tarefaId, select:tarefasParaAcao) but no request fetches a single task. Added public selectTarefa(id | null) and the getter tarefasParaAcao that returns the loaded row with that id.
public selectTarefa is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public tarefasParaAcao is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
